title: כשר לאנ״ש – data files
description: One file, three entry points: #/$defs/placesFile (data/places.json), #/$defs/citiesFile (data/cities.json), #/$defs/metaFile (data/meta.json). Checked by scripts/validate.py with a small built-in validator (stdlib only) that supports exactly the keywords used here: $ref, anyOf, type, enum, const, pattern, minLength, minimum, maximum, required, properties, additionalProperties, propertyNames, items, prefixItems, minItems, maxItems, uniqueItems, plus the annotations title/description/$comment/x-codes. Any other keyword makes validate.py fail, so this file never claims a check that is not run.

text.$comment: No markup characters: the app renders some fields into HTML.

place.description: One place from 'מאגר מסעדות לאנ״ש חב״ד' (ניסן ה׳תשפ״ה). Fields n…fri come from the booklet; g holds data collected later (Google Maps by hand, or OSM).

u.description: Permanent id, used in shared links (?p=) and favourites. Never change or reuse.

n.description: Name as in the booklet (may include '(ליל שישי)').

s.description: Street and number as in the booklet; empty for catering / Shabbat food without an address.

c.description: Town; must be a key of cities.json (checked in validate.py).

r.description: Region from the booklet. Not used by the app.

k.description: Kind (booklet section). The app filters with k.startsWith(…).

t.description: Food type. Empty = not stated in the source; never guessed.

tt.description: Raw food-type text from the booklet (search only).

h.description: Kashrut body exactly as in the booklet, including notes in brackets. Never edited.

hc.description: Kashrut group for the filter and colour only.

p.description: Phone from the booklet ('' if none).

fri.description: Booklet says 'open Thursday night' (ליל שישי). No hours are known from it.

g.description: Data added after the booklet. Without src it was collected by hand from Google Maps in the browser (no API). src:'osm' = location pre-computed from OpenStreetMap Nominatim (scripts/data/geocode.py).

prec.description: poi = the business itself; house = the building address; street = somewhere on the street (approximate).

src.description: Source of loc when not Google Maps. 'osm' = Nominatim/OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL).

week.description: Weekly hours text as shown by Google (Monday first).

chk.description: Month the data in g was checked, YYYY-MM.

q.description: Quality flags for manual review. Computed by scripts/data/flags.py (same rules as validate.py); they never change or hide data. Removing a flag after a manual check is a data decision of the owner.

x-codes.hours-shabbat: A published period is open some time between Friday 17:00 and Saturday 17:00 (Israel). For mehadrin places this is almost always a Google matching error.
x-codes.hours-24h: Open around the clock (00:00–24:00) on at least one day.
x-codes.shared-google: Same Google location (poi/house precision) or same phone as another place with a different town, or a different non-empty street. All members of the group are flagged.
x-codes.approx-loc: The location is only street-level (prec 'street'), so the map pin and distance are approximate.

period.description: [openDay, openHour, openMinute, closeDay, closeHour, closeMinute], day 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday, Israel time. A close earlier than the open wraps to the next week.

citiesFile.description: Town → [lat, lng] of its centre (used for places without an exact location and for candle-lighting time).

rev.description: Raised by 1 on every data change; the app replaces its built-in copy only with a higher rev.
